newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Prudential NZ's investment arm to move to Sydney.
newsitem.headline: Prudential NZ's investment arm to move to Sydney.

text.p: Prudential Assurance NZ Ltd said on Wednesday its investment arm -- Prudential Portfolio Managers (PPM) -- was transferring its functions to Sydney.

PPM managing director Greg Whitten has been appointed chief investment officer for the PPM regional office based in Sydney and will remain responsible for overseeing the management of Prudential New Zealand's investment funds. He will take up his position in May.
Prudential general manager John Molloy said investors in Prudential's New Zealand funds will now be serviced by larger and more strongly resourced teams.

"Currently we have seven investment managers in New Zealand -- with the move to Australia and an expansion of their operation into a regional centre, we will have the expertise of 33 specialist managers, including analysts and economists," Molloy said.
Whitten said Prudential remained committed to seeing its New Zealand funds outperform market benchmarks, using an active rather than passive approach.
"The move to Sydney will undoubtedly increase the quality and depth of investment management available to New Zealand investors," Whitten said.
A new role will be created in Wellington to ensure ongoing service to clients and advisors.
